script.title: AN OVERBOOKED FLIGHT AT THE GATE
script.story_hook: The gate announces an overbooked flight needing volunteers.
script.intro_zh: 登機口廣播航班超賣，需要自願留下的乘客。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, flyers! Today we're at an overbooked gate.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，飛行朋友們！今天我們來到超賣的登機口。
script.outro: Safe travels today! Listen once more before you fly.
script.outro_zh: 祝大家今天旅途平安！搭機前再聽一遍。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the airport lines one by one.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們一句一句跟讀這些機場對話。
script.char_a_description: a busy project manager in his early forties with neatly combed sandy hair, a navy blazer over a checked shirt, a slim laptop bag slung across his back
script.char_b_description: a brisk gate agent in her thirties with a dark chin-length bob, sky-blue airline blazer, a matching neck scarf, a light-blue headset over one ear
script.youtube_title: 【✈️機場英文實境】航班超賣要「讓出座位」？💺自願改簽、🎫三百抵用券、早班機一次聽懂｜出行必學｜Overbooked Flight English
script.youtube_title_en: “Giving Up a Seat” — Handling an Overbooked Flight at the Gate
script.youtube_description:
登機口突然說航班超賣，請人自願讓位，聽得懂也知道自己怎麼反應嗎？這段對話教你問補償、比航班時間、確認座位與行李。18 句美式日常英語附上繁體中文與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，遇狀況不慌張。
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
訂閱頻道，每天一集，讓英語變成直覺！
script.youtube_description_en:
The gate says the flight is overbooked and asks for volunteers — do you understand what's being offered? This dialogue covers asking about compensation, comparing flights, and confirming seats and bags. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA plus a listen-and-repeat finish. Stay cool at any gate.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】✈️航班超賣英文｜自願讓位・補償計算・改簽早班｜聽完就會應對｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
正要登機，卻聽見廣播說這個航班超賣了？
自願讓出座位到底給什麼、要等多久，一句英文都聽得懂嗎？

這一集帶大家走進下午五點的登機口，跟著旅客從確認狀況、問清補償，到比較早班機、改簽成功拿到窗邊座位，全程都是自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
📣 聽懂現場狀況：例如 “This flight's overbooked.”、“Anyone giving up a seat gets compensated.”。
💳 問清補償內容：例如 “How much is the voucher, and when's the next flight?”、“Good for two years, any flight.”。
🎫 確認改簽細節：例如 “Can I keep my window seat?”、“Row eight A, plus free bags.”。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次登機口再鬧超賣，先別急——把條件聽清楚，說不定還能賺一張飛兩年的機票券！
script.thumbnail_action: handing over a reprinted boarding pass

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, the screen changed — what happened to my flight?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ðə skriːn tʃeɪndʒ wʌt ˈhæ·pənd tə maɪ flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，螢幕變了——我的航班怎麼了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, this flight's overbooked tonight.
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，今晚這個航班超賣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Overbooked? Um, so some people can't fly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌoʊ·vərˈbʊkt ʌm soʊ sʌm ˈpi·pəl kænt flaɪ/
dialogue.zh: 超賣？呃，所以有人不能搭這班？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We're asking for volunteers to take a later flight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪr ˈæsk·ɪŋ fər ˌvɑ·lənˈtɪrz tə teɪk ə ˈleɪ·tər flaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我們正在徵求自願改搭晚一點班機的乘客。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anybody giving up a seat gets compensated?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛ·niˌbɑ·di ˈɡɪ·vɪŋ ʌp ə siːt ɡɛts ˈkɑm·pənˌseɪ·tɪd/
dialogue.zh: 讓出座位的人都會得到補償嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes — a three-hundred-dollar voucher with us.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ə θri ˈhʌn·drəd ˈdɑ·lər ˈvaʊ·tʃər wɪð ʌs/
dialogue.zh: 是的——我們給三百美元的搭機抵用券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Huh. And when's the next flight out?
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌ ənd wɛnz ðə nɛkst flaɪt aʊt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯。那下一班什麼時候飛？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow's ten AM, or the seven-fifty early.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑ·roʊz tɛn eɪ ˈɛm ɔr ðə ˈsɛ·vən ˈfɪf·ti ˈɜr·li/
dialogue.zh: 明天上午十點，或早上七點五十那班。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have a meeting at one, so I'd worry.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv ə ˈmi·tɪŋ æt wʌn soʊ aɪd ˈwɜr·i/
dialogue.zh: 我一點有會議，所以我會擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The early one lands at eleven — plenty of time.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði ˈɜr·li wʌn lændz æt ɪˈlɛ·vən plɛn·ti əv taɪm/
dialogue.zh: 早班十一點落地——時間很充裕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would that flight be overbooked, too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's solid — barely half the seats sold.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ˈsɑ·ləd ˈbɛr·li hæf ðə siːts soʊld/
dialogue.zh: 那班很穩——座位只賣了一半出頭。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, is that voucher good on any route?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ɪz ðæt ˈvaʊ·tʃər ɡʊd ɑn ˈɛ·ni ruːt/
dialogue.zh: 那麼，那張券任何航線都能用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any flight we operate, good for two years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛ·ni flaɪt wi ˈɑ·pəˌreɪt ɡʊd fər tu jɪrz/
dialogue.zh: 我們營運的任何航班都能用，有效兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'll volunteer. An early start sounds nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ aɪl ˌvɑ·lənˈtɪr ən ˈɜr·li stɑrt saʊndz naɪs/
dialogue.zh: 好，我願意自願。一早出發聽起來也不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wonderful — let me rebook you right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwʌn·dər·fʊl lɛt mi ˌriːˈbʊk ju raɪt naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了——我現在就幫您改簽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I keep my window seat, row eight?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ kip maɪ ˈwɪn·doʊ siːt roʊ eɪt/
dialogue.zh: 我可以保留第八排的靠窗座位嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Already moved — eight A, plus free bags. Bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːlˈrɛ·d·i muːvd eɪt eɪ plʌs fri bæɡz baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 已經移好了——八A，行李也免費。再見！
